record.question: In the Apple Valley Fire Protection District's 2024 RFP for GASB 75 OPEB actuarial services, as of which dates must the actuary deliver the biennial OPEB valuations and the biennial roll-forward updates?
record.answer:
# Markdown Briefing

## Required OPEB Dates in the 2024 RFP

According to the **Apple Valley Fire Protection District’s 2024 RFP for GASB 75 OPEB actuarial services**, the actuary must provide the following:

### **Biennial OPEB Valuations**
- **June 30, 2024**
- **June 30, 2026**
- **June 30, 2028**

### **Biennial Roll-Forward Updates**
- **June 30, 2025**
- **June 30, 2027**
- **June 30, 2029**

## Summary
The RFP requires **full biennial valuations in even-numbered years** and **roll-forward updates in alternating odd-numbered years**, as stated in the **Scope of Work**.

REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS 
for 
ACTUARIAL SERVICES TO VALUE OTHER POST-EMPLOYMENT BENEFITS 
(OPEB) IN COMPLIANCE WITH GOVERNMENTAL ACCOUNTING STANDARDS
BOARD STATEMENT NO. 75 (GASB 75)
Proposals Due by 11:59 PM, July 31, 2024 
Introduction: 
The Apple Valley Fire Protection District is accepting proposals from qualified consultants 
for Actuarial Services in accordance with the included specifications, terms, and conditions 
included in this Request for Proposal (RFP). Prospective respondents are advised to read 
this information over carefully prior to submitting a proposal. 
A pdf of the proposal should be submitted to the Apple Valley Fire Protection District by 
11:59 PM, July 31, 2024. Proposal shall be submitted via email to: Amber Exley 
(aexley@avfpd.org) with the subject line “Other Post-Employment Benefits Actuarial 
Services”. 
Proposals can alternatively be sent via mail and addressed to: 
Apple Valley Fire Protection District 
Amber Exley, Finance Officer 
RE: Other Post-Employment Benefits Actuarial Services 
22400 Headquarters Drive, Apple Valley, CA 92307

RFP for Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Actuarial Services 
2 
GENERAL INFORMATION 
The Apple Valley Fire Protection District (AVFPD) is seeking proposals from qualified 
professional actuary firms (Actuary) to provide services to value Other Post-Employment 
Benefits (OPEB) in compliance with Governmental Accounting Standards Board Statement 
No. 75 (GASB 75) for inclusion in AVFPD’s Comprehensive Annual Financial Report as of 
June 30, 2024, and beyond. 
Said valuations must be performed in accordance with generally accepted actuarial 
standards of practice promulgated by the Actuarial Standards Board and based on the 
actuarial assumptions and methods prescribed by the California Public Employees’ 
Retirement System (CalPERS) Board. The required services and performance conditions 
are described in the Scope of Work. 
There is no expressed or implied obligation of AVFPD to reimburse responding firms for 
any expense incurred in preparing proposals in response to this request. During the 
evaluation process, the AVFPD reserves the right, where it may serve AVFPD’s best 
interest, to request additional information or clarifications from proposers, or to allow 
corrections of errors or omissions. 
AVFPD reserves the right to retain all proposals submitted and to use any ideas in a 
proposal regardless of whether that proposal is selected. Submission of a proposal 
indicates acceptance by the firm of the conditions contained in this request for proposal, 
unless clearly and specifically noted in the proposal submitted and confirmed in the 
contract between AVFPD and the firm selected. 
To be considered, a proposal must be received by 11:59 PM, July 31, 2024. Please see the 
Instructions to Submitting Firms in this document for further information. 
BACKGROUND 
The Apple Valley Fire Protection District was formed in 1951 and was incorporated as a 
Fire District in 1962 under the California Health and Safety Code, Local Fire District Law of 
1961. AVFPD is located approximately 90 miles northeast of Los Angeles and provides fire 
service to a population of approximately 94,000 residents within a service area of 
approximately 206 square miles. AVFPD employs 59 full-time employees. AVFPD’s 
Adopted Budget for fiscal year 2024 totals $15.5 million.

RFP for Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Actuarial Services 
3 
AVFPD contracts with the California Public Employees’ Retirement System to provide 
retirement benefits under California Government Code section 22825.5. AVFPD provides 
a monthly health insurance reimbursement to retirees up to a maximum contribution set 
by AVFPD’s Board of Directors, based on years of service and position held. As of 
December 1, 2007, the plan is closed to new employees, excluding Firer Chief, Deputy Fire 
Chief, Finance Officer, Division Chief, Battalion Chief, Fire Marshal, Deputy Fire Marshal, 
Fleet Services Manager and Administrative Services Manager. 
SCOPE OF WORK 
The Apple Valley Fire Protection District is seeking proposals from qualified firms 
interested in providing actuarial services to AVFPD for valuation of OPEB offered by 
AVFPD. The Actuary must at a minimum: 
1. Prepare actuarial valuations in compliance with the reporting requirements of all 
applicable GASB statements, including but not limited to, GASB Statements 74 and 
75 and any future GASB pronouncements and governmental accounting reporting 
requirements. 
2. Deliver OPEB related biennial valuations as of June 30, 2024, June 30, 2026, and 
June 30, 2028. 
3. Deliver OPEB biennial roll-forward updates as of June 30, 2025, June 30, 2027, and 
June 30, 2029. 
4. Recommended contributions/plan funding for Fiscal Year (FY) 2025 – 2030. 
5. Prepare necessary information for inclusion in AVFPD’s Comprehensive Annual 
Financial Report to comply with current and future GASB pronouncement reporting 
and disclosure requirements. 
6. Provide all documents and information (including the actuarial certification, 
funding policy certification, and Excel valuation information spreadsheet) required 
by CalPERS for agencies funding with the California Employers’’ Retiree Benefit 
Trust (CERBT) along with a certified final valuation results outline.

RFP for Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Actuarial Services 
4 
7. Meet with AVFPD in person or virtually as needed, to make necessary decisions 
and report progress on valuations, including auditor related inquiries and financial 
reporting issues. 
8. Assistance in implementing any new GASB statements and other financial 
pronouncements related to OPEB and providing ongoing professional 
consultation. 
9. Working Paper Retention - All working papers and reports must be retained, at the 
Actuary's expense, for a minimum of seven (7) years after the last year of the 
contract, unless the Actuary is notified in writing by AVFPD of the need to extend 
the retention period. The Actuary will be required to make working papers available 
upon request, including, but not limited to, AVFPD or its designees. The Actuary 
shall work with AVFPD staff and financial auditors as needed to comply with GASB 
75 requirements and Comprehensive Annual Financial Report preparation and 
audits. 
10. The Actuary shall respond to the reasonable inquiries of successor Actuaries and 
allow successor Actuaries to review working papers relating to matters of 
continuing GASB and accounting significance, if needed. 
11. AVFPD shall be free to publish the valuations and reports as they see fit without 
obtaining prior permission from the Actuary as long as they are not used in a 
potentially misleading manner and no material subsequent event has occurred that 
might render the valuation and reports potentially misleading. 
12. The proposal package shall present all-inclusive actuarial fees for each year of the 
contract term. Actuarial fees associated with optional extensions exercised by 
AVFPD will be negotiated at the time of contract extension. AVFPD requires the 
total costs be stated as a “not to exceed” basis and shall be inclusive of labor, travel, 
report preparation, printing, and all other expenses incurred by the Actuary. 
PROPOSAL REQUIREMENTS 
The following is a list of the information to be provided. A proposal that does not include 
the information required below may be deemed non-responsive and subject to rejection.

RFP for Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Actuarial Services 
5 
Firms are encouraged to be brief and relevant to the specific information requested. 
Proposals should be straight forward, concise, and provide “layman”: explanation of 
technical terms that are used. 
1. Provide a cover letter on company letterhead addressing the proposal. The letter 
shall be signed by an officer of the Actuary firm authorized to bind the firm to all 
comments made in the proposal, and shall include the name, address, and phone 
number of the person(s) to contact who will be authorized to represent Actuary 
firm. 
2. The respondent’s proposal must include a project plan for the actuarial services 
engagement to be performed under this RFP for the valuation of other 
postemployment benefits. The project plan should include, at a minimum, the 
following: 
a. Approach and methodology for the valuation. 
b. Approach and methodology to include compliance with GASB standards. 
c. Data requirements from AVFPD. 
d. Identification of project plan milestones 
e. Schedule for project completion and issuance of report 
f. Valuation report elements to include: 
i. Actuarial present value of total projected benefits. 
ii. Actuarial accrued liability. 
iii. OPEB assets both market value and actuarial value. 
iv. Unfunded actuarial accrued liability. 
v. Normal cost. 
vi. Annual required contribution as a dollar amount and as a 
percentage of Payroll. 
vii. Annual OPEB cost. 
viii. Net OPEB obligation. 
ix. Summary of data used for the valuation. 
x. Summary of actuarial methods and assumptions. 
xi. Financial notes to be included in the AVFPD’s audited financial 
statements in the GASB prescribed format. 
3. Describe the governmental experience of the firm including the specific details 
regarding experience in the area of actuarial valuation services related to OPEB. 
4. Provide a list of municipal government references where the firm has provided 
OPEB actuarial valuation services in the past thirty-six (36) months. This list should

RFP for Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Actuarial Services 
6 
indicate the names and contact information of finance officers in these 
municipalities. 
5. Provide information regarding staffing including the experience of the individuals 
who will be assigned to the engagement. This should also include each individual’s 
relevant experience with municipalities and preparing OPEB actuarial valuations. 
Also, include information as to the annual training plan of the firm related to 
governmental services. 
6. Provide a complete schedule of fees (one time or reoccurring) for all scope of 
services. 
7. For additional services requested by AVFPD that are not included within the scope 
of the routine services outlined in the RFP, please indicate your hourly time 
charges. 
8. Provide a sample actuarial valuation. 
9. Provide a sample of the additional information needed to prepare necessary notes 
for the financial statements to be included in AVFPD’s audited financial statements, 
including, but not limited to, notes and required supplementary information. 
10. Provide your latest financial statement and describe in detail the financial history 
and resources of your firm, to show financial stability. Disclose any settlements or 
legal claims where litigation is currently pending or has occurred against your firm 
within the last five years. 
EVALUATION CRITERIA 
AVFPD will evaluate the responses and make a recommendation to the AVFPD Board for 
approval. The evaluation committee will consider the following factors: 
1. Understanding of the services required. 
2. Quality, clarity, and responsiveness of proposal. 
3. Proposed fees.

RFP for Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Actuarial Services 
7 
4. Information provided by client references. 
5. Demonstrated competence and professional qualifications necessary for 
successfully performing the work required. 
6. Background and related experience of the principal individuals to be assigned to 
provide services. 
7. Approach in providing OPEB Trust actuarial consulting services. 
8. Interviews, if conducted. 
SELECTION PROCESS 
1. AVFPD will initially review all responses to determine responsiveness. Any response 
that does not address all requested requirements or is incomplete will be rejected. 
2. AVFPD will evaluate all responses based on the criteria stated above. The 
evaluation committee may afford organizations the opportunity to clarify 
responses for the purpose of assuring a full understanding of their responsiveness 
to the RFP. 
3. AVFPD may conduct interviews with firms found to be the most qualified to 
perform the services required, based upon the criteria listed in this RFP. If so, the 
firms will be notified in advance of the proposed interview date. 
4. All responding firms will be notified in writing once one or more organizations have 
been selected and approved. 
INSTRUCTIONS TO SUBMITTING FIRMS 
1. Examination of Proposal Documents 
By submitting a proposal, the prospective firm represents that it has thoroughly 
examined and become familiar with the services required under this RFP, and that 
it can deliver quality services to AVFPD in a creative, cost-effective, and service-oriented manner.

RFP for Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Actuarial Services 
8 
2. Questions/Clarifications 
Please direct any questions regarding this RFP to Amber Exley, Finance Officer at 
aexley@avfpd.org. Questions must be received via email by 4:00pm on July 29, 
2024 
3. Submission of Proposals 
Complete written proposals must be submitted via email or via mail in sealed 
envelopes marked and received no later than 11:59 PM PDT on July 31, 2024, to 
the address below. Proposals will not be accepted after this deadline. 
Emailed to: aexley@avfpd.org with the subject line “Other Post-Employment 
Benefits Actuarial Services”. 
Or mailed to: 
Apple Valley Fire Protection District 
Amber Exley, Finance Officer 
RE: Other Post-Employment Benefits Actuarial Services 
22400 Headquarters Drive 
Apple Valley, CA 92307 
4. Withdrawal of Proposals 
A firm may withdraw its proposal at any time before the due date for submission 
of proposals as provided in the RFP by delivering a written request for withdrawal 
signed by, or on behalf of the prospective firm. 
5. Rights of the Apple Valley Fire Protection District 
This RFP does not commit AVFPD to award a contract, nor does it obligate AVFPD 
to pay for any costs incurred in preparation and submission of proposals or in 
anticipation of a contract. 
AVFPD reserves the right to: 
a. Make the selection based on its sole discretion; 
b. Reject any and all proposals without prejudice; 
c. Issue subsequent Requests for Proposal; 
d. Postpone opening for its own convenience; 
e. Remedy technical errors in the Request for Proposal process; 
f. Approve or disapprove the use of particular sub-contractors;

RFP for Other Post-Employment Benefits (OPEB) Trust Actuarial Services 
9 
g. Negotiate with any all, or none of the prospective firms; 
h. Solicit best and final offers from all or some of the prospective firms; 
i. Accept other than the lowest offer; and/or 
j. Waive informalities and irregularities in the proposal process. 
6. Response Submission 
Responses must include a cover letter indicating the mailing address of the office 
from which the response is submitted, the name of the individual who will 
represent the firm as the primary contact person for the response, and the 
telephone number and email information of the primary contact person. 
 
7. Administrative Specifications 
a. All responses must be irrevocable for 180 days and signed by an authorized 
officer of the firm. 
b. Successful responding firms must agree to provide AVFPD with audit access 
on request during the term of the contract and for 7 years thereafter. 
c. AVFPD at any time, in its sole discretion, may terminate its contract with the 
selected organization or postpone or delay all or any part of the contract, 
upon written notice to the selected firm. 
8. Contract Approval 
After Board approval, staff will commence contract negotiations with the selected 
proposer. If a satisfactory contract cannot be negotiated in a reasonable time, 
AVFPD, in its sole discretion may terminate negotiations with the initially selected 
proposer and begin contract negotiations with the next highest ranked proposer. 
9. Conclusion 
By submitting a proposal, each prospective firm represents and warrants that its 
proposal is genuine and not a sham or collusive or made in the interest of or on 
behalf of any person not named therein; that the prospective firm has not directly, 
induced or solicited any other person to submit a sham proposal or any other 
person to refrain from submitting a proposal; and, that the prospective firm has 
not in any manner sought collusion to secure any improper advantage over any 
other person submitting a proposal.

# Markdown Briefing

## Required OPEB Dates in the 2024 RFP

According to the **Apple Valley Fire Protection District’s 2024 RFP for GASB 75 OPEB actuarial services**, the actuary must provide the following:

### **Biennial OPEB Valuations**
- **June 30, 2024**
- **June 30, 2026**
- **June 30, 2028**

### **Biennial Roll-Forward Updates**
- **June 30, 2025**
- **June 30, 2027**
- **June 30, 2029**

## Summary
The RFP requires **full biennial valuations in even-numbered years** and **roll-forward updates in alternating odd-numbered years**, as stated in the **Scope of Work**.
